channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Hyde Park Neighborhood Club Finishes 1st Phase Of Renovation
item.description: The century-old club for Hyde Park kids and families recently unveiled its culinary classroom, lounge and accessibility upgrades. A gym expansion, greenhouse and outdoor play areas are coming as leaders continue to fundraise.

item.title: 2 Fires Hit Avondale In Less Than 24 Hours, Killing 1
item.description: Another fire earlier this month in nearby Logan Square temporarily closed the burger restaurant Small Cheval.

item.title: Edgewater Synagogue Redevelopment Includes Hundreds Of Apartments, Retail Space
item.description: Leaders of Emanuel Congregation submitted a zoning change request for their plan to build a 12-story complex with a synagogue on Sheridan Road and an apartment building across the street.

item.title: ‘Abolish ICE’ Submitted 9,200 Times For Chicago Snowplow Naming Contest, Records Show
item.description: Anti-ICE sentiments made up nearly 80 percent of submissions. Voting for the top six names opens Sunday and runs through Feb. 14.

item.title: Immigration Committee Wants COPA To Investigate Whether Police Helped ICE
item.description: The Civilian Office for Police Accountability could soon be tasked with investigating when city police are accused of helping federal immigration agents under a proposed ordinance.

item.title: Extreme Cold Delays Western Brown Line Station Bus Turnaround Renovations
item.description: The next phase of construction could take two and a half weeks to complete, depending on the weather, officials said.

item.title: 6 Theater Shows To Check Out This February
item.description: The classic drama “Come Back, Little Sheba” from famed American playwright William Inge and an exploration of Black entrepreneur A.G. Gaston’s life are among the productions coming to Chicago stages.

item.title: Fugitive Ex-Loretto Leader At Center Of $300 Million COVID Scandal Arrested In Serbia
item.description: Anosh Ahmed had been living abroad — with federal prosecutors calling him a "fugitive" — since shortly before prosecutors brought charges against him in the Loretto Hospital case.

item.title: 6 Broadview Protesters Ask For Evidence To Be Made Public, Citing Minneapolis Shootings
item.description: Attorneys for Kat Abughazaleh and five other people charged are also asking the government to specify what their clients are being charged with, calling the conspiracy charges “broad and vague.”

item.title: Pilsen Alderman Byron Sigcho-Lopez Announces Run For Congress
item.description: Ald. Byron Sigcho-Lopez officially announced his run for the 4th congressional district as an independent democratic socialist candidate. The 25th Ward alderman still needs to collect about 10,000 petition signatures to get on the ballot.
